facts.claim: Entry shape: hooks.<Event>[] = {matcher (regex, unanchored, optional), hooks: [{type: command, command (run with sh -c), timeout (seconds, default 30), on_failure: allow|block}]}
Fail-closed switch: on_failure: "block" per PreToolUse action; default allow; any other value skips the plugin's whole hooks.json
Matcher "*" is an invalid regex and silently skips the rule; use .* or omit
Stdin: event, session_id, matcher_context, tool_name, tool_input, tool_call_id, working_dir; no MCP server field

Decision order: exit 2 denies (stderr reason); stdout {"decision":"block"} denies at any exit; exit 0 + empty stdout allows; exit 0 + {"decision":"allow"} allows; anything else is no decision (hook failure)
No ask value and no input rewrite on PreToolUse

facts.claim: Timeout, spawn error, invalid UTF-8, malformed JSON, signal: hook failure, which allows by default and denies under on_failure: block
Names: extension tools {extension}__{tool}; developer/analyze/summon/code_execution tools bare: shell, write, edit, tree, read_image; shell input keys command, timeout_secs
Denial message to model: Tool call denied by policy hook `<plugin>`: <reason>. Do not retry; ...
Nothing in PreToolUse ends the run; only a Stop hook can block a turn from ending (capped by GOOSE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP)
Default GOOSE_MODE is Auto when unset
